mapper.select: select * from ( select BO.BID_ID bidId, ee.finprod_id finprodId, fp.FINPROD_ABBR finprodAbbr, ee.Entrust_Date biddate, fp.trade_market tradeMarket, ee.counter_id counterId, bo.remark remark, row_number() over() as rownum from ETR_ENTRUST ee INNER JOIN ETR_DISTRIBUTE edb on ee.entrust_id = edb.entrust_id left join BID_ORDER_BID_PRICE bobp on ee.entrust_id = bobp.entrust_id left join BID_ORDER BO ON bobp.bid_id = BO.BID_ID left join ETR_ENTRUST_BID_PRICE eebp on ee.entrust_id = eebp.entrust_id left join FIN_PRODUCT fp ON fp.FINPROD_ID = ee.FINPROD_ID where edb.rec_status = #{entruststatusyjs} and ee.finprod_type2 = #{pinanassettypeyj} and ee.finprod_id = #{finprodId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} and ee.counter_id =#{counterId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND instr(','||#{entrustId}||',', ','||ee.ENTRUST_ID||',') > 0 ) where rownum = 1
